checks.evidence: Company representative reports unauthorized access, step 3: report submitted and confirmation message displayed that the report has been received (also Company representative reports potential compromise, step 3).

invented: Test 'Non-representative user cannot report account compromise' asserts that a citizen user cannot see or use the reporting option; the requirement does not state this restriction on other user types, although it is written as an assumption.

Reporting is assumed to be located in an account security or support section and to use a form with a description field; these UI details are not in the requirement, although the assumptions partly cover them.
